title: Lead-to-Lease Marketing & Leasing
purpose: Focused list of marketing and leasing competitors in the lead-to-lease funnel. For intern project research.
research_areas: Lead Generation: How do they capture leads? (Website, ads, referrals)
Lead Nurturing: How do they follow up? (Emails, SMS, calls, chatbots)
Tour Booking: How do they schedule and manage tours? (AI scheduling, calendar)
Application Process: Do they help with applications? (Forms, document collection)
Lease Signing: Do they support lease generation and signing?
Integration: How do they integrate with PMS? (API, native, manual)
Pricing Models: Per unit, per lead, per property, flat fee?
Customer Evidence: Who uses them? What results do they report?
Gaps vs. Entrata: Where does Entrata have advantages? Where are we behind?
